title.value: GrowSpace: A reinforcement learning environment for plant architecture
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: GrowSpace: A reinforcement learning environment for plant architecture

extractions.description: The paper introduces GrowSpace, a reinforcement learning environment for simulating plant growth and responses to light, allowing for the testing of hypotheses related to plant behavior and control.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is directly related to improving plant growth and understanding plant behavior, which is essential for sustainable agriculture and food security.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We propose the GrowSpace simulator that is built within a reinforcement learning framework, providing a sandbox environment to test out hypotheses. GrowSpace currently focuses on the behavioral response of plants to light displacement, with the objective of controlling a plant’s shape by moving a light source.

primary_category.justification: The research focuses on optimizing plant growth which can lead to more efficient agriculture and potentially reduce land use and associated emissions.
primary_category.quote: Tasks are crafted and tested with artificial intelligence algorithms to further understand the concept of plant growth control through light. We equally demonstrate that sequential control of plant branching is hard challenge for the plant science community as well as the reinforcement learning community.

primary_sub_category.justification: The simulator is designed to better understand and control plant growth, directly impacting agricultural practices.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this paper we propose a simulator, GrowSpace, that encompasses generic branching properties, permits for dynamic plant–environment interactions, and provides modularity for future researchers.

applications.value: Precision agriculture for increased efficiency and reduced Greenhouse Gases (GHG) emissions related to land use
applications.justification: The GrowSpace simulator aims to optimize plant growth, which can be directly applied to precision agriculture to improve efficiency and reduce environmental impact.
applications.quote: GrowSpace provides an artificial modular environment that is simulated to the advancements of plant biological systems all while using a reinforcement learning framework.
